mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, username, nickname, avatar_url AS avatarUrl, phone, email, exp, level, status, role, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_follow WHERE following_id = u.user_id) AS followersCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_follow WHERE follower_id = u.user_id) AS followingCount, birthday, bio, gender FROM user u WHERE user_id = #{userid}

SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar_url, u.phone, u.email, u.exp, u.level, u.status, u.role, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_follow WHERE following_id = u.user_id) AS followers_count, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_follow WHERE follower_id = u.user_id) AS following_count, u.birthday, u.bio, u.gender FROM user u WHERE u.user_id = #{uid}
